summary.pose_basis: 24 named joint-state references (zero, signed single-axis quarter turns, six fully extended world directions, combined folded/wrist states) plus 984 deterministic Halton states across six joint angles in [-pi, pi). Joint states are common to every design; fully extended tests resolve analytically for each design. Reach bounds constrain maximum shoulder-to-TCP extension, not a workspace shell. Global collision and joint-stop checks disabled.
summary.ik_policy: joint-state references applied directly; named extension poses resolved analytically
summary.score_definition: conservative zero-to-P payload over the finite velocity basis and acceleration box; motor dynamic torque capped by continuous rating
summary.capacity_model: continuous-rated motors; rated reducer holding and repeated-peak motion; ideal lossless 1:1 input belts
summary.known_constraints_definition: Static motor continuous/reducer rated holding plus reducer motion limit and supported speeds. Omits the unverified dynamic motor transient constraint; not a complete arm payload rating.
summary.duty_cycle_policy: No timed operating cycle or manufacturer equivalent-load rule is supplied. Repeated-peak comparison is instantaneous screening only; no cycle-average, thermal or lifetime pass is inferred. Momentary/emergency torque ratings are not used.
summary.motor_envelope_assumption: Per motor: rated_continuous uses published continuous torque from rest through rated rpm with no extrapolation; legacy_linear uses min(rated torque, stall*(1-rpm/no-load)). Known mechanical maxima enforced. No measured thermal curve.
summary.reducer_input_torque_policy: Published output ratings enforced; input-shaft torque constraint applied only when separately published. Unpublished input limits remain unverified.
summary.motor_rotor_inertia_assumption: Published rotor inertia when available; otherwise explicit conservative upper bound M_motor * R_envelope^2. Unpublished rotor values remain null in source inputs.
summary.payload_inertia_model: TCP-centered sphere, radius 10 mm, inertia per kg 4e-5 m2
summary.unknown_reducer_rotating_inertia: omitted; complete reducer case mass on parent
summary.jg_definition: weighted mean of squared gravity torques divided by the common reducer rated limits at required payload

hardware_coverage.mode: exhaustive motor tuples with independent bounded geometry searches
hardware_coverage.seed_failure_scope: Only the recorded bounded seed probes; not a proof that no geometry can fit
